snippet.title: FOF (Fear of Failure) – Announcement trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now  https://store.steampowered.com/app/4036580/FOF_Fear_Of_Failure/

FOF (Fear of Failure) is a physics-based precision platformer where every shot counts. Use the powerful recoil of your shotgun to propel yourself through challenging environments, overcoming obstacles with skill and strategy. Balance on the edge of success — one wrong move, one moment of fear, and you’ll experience spectacular failure.
